scripts.bundle: pnpm build && pnpm ui && node scripts/bundle.mjs
scripts.test:bundle: pnpm build && pnpm ui && node --test scripts/test-bundle.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @ecs/web test:build && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning scripts/run-tests.mjs
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm ui-check && pnpm check-drift && pnpm secret-scan && node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs
scripts.test:browser: pnpm build && pnpm ui && pnpm --filter @ecs/web test:browser
